softwareInnerHero.title: Comprehensive Catchment Modeling for Water Infrastructure
paragraphs: Autodesk InfoWorks ICM is the industry-leading integrated catchment modeling software that enables water utilities, engineering firms, and government agencies to simulate and analyze the complete water cycle within a single platform.

With InfoWorks ICM, you can model rainfall-runoff, river flow, urban drainage, and wastewater systems in an integrated environment. The software combines 1D and 2D hydraulic modeling capabilities with advanced water quality analysis to provide a complete picture of water infrastructure performance.

From master planning and system design to operational management and flood risk assessment, InfoWorks ICM provides the tools you need to make informed decisions about water infrastructure investments and operations.

cardSections.subheading: Discover how InfoWorks ICM transforms water infrastructure modeling

items.title: Integrated 1D/2D Modeling
items.body: Simulate both pipe networks (1D) and surface flooding (2D) in a single model to accurately predict flood behavior and identify at-risk areas.

items.title: Rainfall-Runoff Modeling
items.body: Model the complete rainfall-runoff process using multiple methods including SCS, Green-Ampt, and SWMM to understand how rainfall becomes runoff in your catchment.

items.title: Water Quality Analysis
items.body: Analyze water quality parameters including pollutants, sediments, and nutrients to assess environmental impact and treatment requirements.

items.title: GIS Integration
items.body: Leverage geospatial data and mapping capabilities to visualize models, analyze spatial relationships, and communicate results effectively.

items.title: Real-Time Control
items.body: Model and optimize real-time control strategies for pumps, gates, and other control structures to improve system performance and resilience.

items.title: Scenario Analysis
items.body: Evaluate multiple scenarios including climate change, urbanization, and infrastructure improvements to develop robust long-term strategies.
